_metadata.description: PRD + requirements contract checks: template shape, section content, OT↔requirement linkage in both directions, registry structure, validation-ref existence.

requirements.title: Template section conformance checks
requirements.description: Missing required PRD template sections, unexpected sections, and placeholder/insufficient section content are each detected as distinct findings, using section definitions extracted by packages/intent-go (the single parser).

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/checks/template_test.go. Table-driven fixtures per finding code: missing section, unexpected section, placeholder content, conformant PRD.

requirements.title: OT↔requirement linkage in both directions
requirements.description: A requirement whose prd_ref matches no PRD operational target and an operational target with no requirement pointing at it are both detected (intent.prd_ref_unmatched, intent.ot_orphan) via intent-go checks.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/checks/linkage_test.go. Fixtures for dangling prd_ref, orphaned OT, and fully linked contract; asserts finding codes and severities.

requirements.title: Registry structural validation
requirements.description: Duplicate requirement IDs, import cycles, orphaned imports, missing id/title/status, invalid status vocabulary, starter-template residue, and requirements with no validation are detected with the same finding codes the native test-genie business phase emits today.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/checks/registry_test.go. One positive and one negative fixture per structural finding code.

requirements.title: Validation-ref existence and mini-format handling
requirements.description: validation[].ref entries are normalized through intent-go's Ref mini-format (#fragment, ::TestName, globs); refs to files that do not exist on disk emit intent.ref_missing; manual-typed validations are never path-checked.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/checks/refs_test.go. Covers path refs, ::TestName refs, globs, doc anchors, and manual prose refs.

requirements.title: Parity with the native business phase
requirements.description: On real scenarios, validate-scenario output is parity-or-explained against test-genie's native business phase findings before the delegation cutover: every difference is enumerated and justified line-by-line.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/checks/parity_test.go. Golden assessment outputs for fixture scenarios mirroring native-phase behavior; the live parity report is produced during Phase 3/7 validation.

requirements.title: All parsing lives in intent-go
requirements.description: business-health contains no PRD.md or requirements/ parsing of its own; api/internal/extraction is a thin composition over packages/intent-go extractors, preserving the repo-wide single-parser ratchet.

validation.notes: Planned ref: api/internal/extraction/extraction_test.go. Asserts extraction package only composes intent-go types; repo ratchet test in intent-go remains green.
